name: html-to-markdown
description: Convert raw HTML into Markdown and plain text, with optional main-content extraction.

HTML2MD_DEFAULT_BASE_URL.description: Optional default base URL used to resolve relative links when base_url is not provided in inputs.

html.description: Raw HTML to convert into Markdown and plain text.

base_url.description: Optional base URL for resolving relative links in the HTML.

main_content_only.description: If true, try to extract the main article/content (readability-style) and drop nav/boilerplate.

preserve_links.description: If true, keep hyperlinks as Markdown links instead of stripping URLs.

preserve_images.description: If true, keep images as Markdown image tags where possible.

markdown.description: Markdown representation of the input HTML.

text.description: Plain-text representation of the input HTML.

metadata.description: Optional metadata about the conversion process (e.g. character counts, heuristics used).

content_length_markdown.description: Length of the markdown string in characters.

content_length_text.description: Length of the text string in characters.

main_content_extracted.description: True if main-content extraction was applied.

code.description: Stable machine-readable error code (e.g. INPUT_INVALID, PARSE_FAILED).

details.description: Optional structured context (e.g. truncated input, parse error info).
